title: RF Activity Exposure Knowledge Object (v1.0 Phase 2A)
$comment: NON-EXECUTABLE structural schema for draft Rectus Femoris activity exposure metadata. Unknown top-level fields are disallowed (additionalProperties:false). Objects must remain draft/pending, clinically not approved, non-executable, metadata-only, and runtime-disconnected. This schema carries NO active prescription fields, NO active dosage fields, NO clearance fields, NO readiness authorization fields, NO progression authorization fields, and NO runtime integration beyond inert metadata. RF-ACT objects are activity/sport/conditioning exposure DOMAINS, not exercises, plans, prescriptions, progressions, readiness gates, or RTT/RTS/clearance authority. They are not runtime-selectable until future governed activity-exposure rules exist.

activity_exposure_id.description: Stable unique identifier for an RF activity exposure object. Empty string is permitted only in the blank template.

source_exercise_object_id.description: The RF-EX exercise object this activity-exposure object was staged from (non-destructive). Empty string only in the blank template. The original RF-EX object is never modified.

allowed_when.description: Inert metadata context only. Never a runtime-selection trigger.

monitoring_triggers.description: Non-prescriptive qualitative signals only. No numeric thresholds.

restricted_context.description: Restricted-source marker, e.g. "none" for non-restricted exposures.
